name: medimage-platform
description: Medical Text and Image Processing (AIDS 12605.1) - Adani Institute of Higher Education and Research

scripts.build: node -e "try { const fs=require('fs'), cp=require('child_process'), path=require('path'); const venvDir=path.resolve('.venv'); const venvPy=process.platform==='win32'?path.join(venvDir,'Scripts','python.exe'):path.join(venvDir,'bin','python'); const venvPip=process.platform==='win32'?path.join(venvDir,'Scripts','pip.exe'):path.join(venvDir,'bin','pip'); if(!fs.existsSync(venvPy)) { console.log('🌱 Setting up .venv during build...'); cp.execSync('python3 -m venv .venv || python -m venv .venv', {stdio:'inherit'}); } cp.execSync((fs.existsSync(venvPip)?('"'+venvPip+'"'):'pip') + ' install --no-cache-dir -r backend/requirements.txt', {stdio:'inherit'}); } catch(e){ console.log('Notice: ' + e.message); }" && npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/.next/standalone')) { fs.cpSync('frontend/public', 'frontend/.next/standalone/public', {recursive:true}); fs.mkdirSync('frontend/.next/standalone/.next', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('frontend/.next/static', 'frontend/.next/standalone/.next/static', {recursive:true}); console.log('✅ Standalone static & public assets synced.'); }"
